sampleSentences: The night before the exam, Amber played video games until very late and did not study.
The next morning, she felt very tired and could not focus on the test.
When the teacher asked everyone to hand in their papers, Amber had not finished hers.
She regretted staying up late and promised herself that she would prepare well next time.
paragraph: The night before the exam, Amber played video games until very late and did not study. The next morning, she felt very tired and could not focus on the test. When the teacher asked everyone to hand in their papers, Amber had not finished hers. She regretted staying up late and promised herself that she would prepare well next time.
notes: 此為另一份可成立參考段落；中圖依可見打呵欠寫疲倦不專心，不把睡著當原圖確定事實。反思結尾為合理寫作補充，非原圖台詞。
